title: ITCO Tank Container Digital Twin - BoxTech Tanks
description: Recommended starting point for the ITCO Digital Twin: the 14 core data points behind the first use case, carriers onboarding shipper-owned tank containers. Covers the fields of the v1.7 message that BIC BoxTech reads and holds as the tank container's technical record when a Digital Twin is uploaded (POST /api/v2.0/tank). Eleven fields are mandatory for BoxTech; the rest are recommended. Any other Digital Twin content is allowed, is stored by BoxTech in full and is returned unchanged. Two BoxTech rules cannot be expressed here: the check digit must be correct for the container number, and tare weight plus maximum payload must equal maximum gross weight.

TankContainerDigitalTwin.description: Root object of the Digital Twin message.

digitalTwin.description: Message header. Recommended. Not part of the BoxTech technical record, but stored with the twin.

lastUpdatedDate.description: Date the Digital Twin was last updated, as YYYY-MM-DD.

version.description: Version of the ITCO Digital Twin message format the payload follows.

tankBasicInformation.description: Identity and design data of the tank container.

assetIdentification.description: Who the tank is. BICCode, serialNumber and checkDigit are combined into the 11-character BoxTech container_number.

BICCode.description: Mandatory for BoxTech. ISO 6346 owner prefix (three letters) plus equipment category identifier (U, J or Z). First four characters of BoxTech container_number.

serialNumber.description: Mandatory for BoxTech. Six-digit ISO 6346 serial number, sent as a string so leading zeros are kept. Characters 5 to 10 of BoxTech container_number.

checkDigit.description: Mandatory for BoxTech. Single ISO 6346 check digit, sent as a string. Last character of BoxTech container_number. BoxTech rejects the upload if it is not correct for the BIC code and serial number.

manufacturerName.description: Recommended. Name of the tank manufacturer. Maps to BoxTech manufacturer.

manufactureDate.description: Recommended. Date of manufacture, as YYYY-MM-DD. Maps to BoxTech manufacture_date.

manufacturerSerialNumber.description: Recommended. Serial number given to the tank by its manufacturer. Maps to BoxTech manufacture_number.

operator.description: Recommended. Company currently operating the tank. Maps to BoxTech current_operator.

lastTest.description: Recommended. The most recent periodic test. Its testDate is the Inspection Date of the 14 core data points.

testDate.description: Date the test was carried out, as YYYY-MM-DD.

nextTest.description: Recommended. The next periodic test due. Its testDate is the Next Inspection Date of the 14 core data points, which carriers check against the voyage dates.

testDate.description: Date the test is due, as YYYY-MM-DD.

designSpecification.description: Design weights, capacity and tank codes. Tare weight plus maximum payload must equal maximum gross weight, or BoxTech rejects the upload.

tareWeight.description: Mandatory for BoxTech. Weight of the empty tank container in kilograms. Maps to BoxTech tare_kg.

maximumGrossWeight.description: Mandatory for BoxTech. Maximum permitted weight of the tank container and its cargo in kilograms. Maps to BoxTech max_gross_mass_kg.

maximumPayload.description: Mandatory for BoxTech. Maximum permitted cargo weight in kilograms. Maps to BoxTech max_payload_kg.

capacity.description: Mandatory for BoxTech. Capacity of the tank in litres. Maps to BoxTech capacity_litres; BoxTech computes cubic_capacity_cbm from it.

RIDADRTankCode.description: Mandatory for BoxTech. RID/ADR tank code. Maps to BoxTech adr_rid_code.

Tcode.description: Mandatory for BoxTech. UN portable tank instruction (IMDG T code). Maps to BoxTech imdg_code.

TCode.description: ITCO v1.5 spelling of Tcode, still accepted by BoxTech. Send Tcode for v1.7.

bafflesFitted.description: Mandatory for BoxTech. Whether baffles are fitted. Maps to BoxTech baffles (yes becomes true, no becomes false).

frame.description: The container frame around the tank.

ISO6346SizeTypeCode.description: Mandatory for BoxTech. ISO 6346 size type code. Must be a valid code; BoxTech cannot record a container without it. Maps to BoxTech detail_st.

length.description: Recommended. External length in millimetres. Maps to BoxTech external_length_mm. BoxTech takes external dimensions from the ISO standard for the size type code, and uses this value only where the code has no standard dimensions.

width.description: Recommended. External width in millimetres. Maps to BoxTech external_width_mm. Used by BoxTech only where the size type code has no standard dimensions.

height.description: Recommended. External height in millimetres. Maps to BoxTech external_height_mm. Used by BoxTech only where the size type code has no standard dimensions.

stackingCapacity.description: Recommended. Permitted stacking load in kilograms. Maps to BoxTech stacking_kg.

rackingForce.description: Recommended. Racking test force in newtons. Maps to BoxTech racking_n; BoxTech derives the value in kilograms.
